'''Sano Thrica''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he became part of the [[Order of Revan]], joining with the Revanite forces on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Thrica and his fellow Revanites tried to stop a strike team from reaching [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[temple of Sacrifice artifact]], but were defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sano Thrica appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

Sano's name is an anagram to [[Carth Onasi]].
